description: One component an SBOM lists, with its scope, and for a distro package (deb, rpm, apk) the OSV package it is asked as when the SBOM states its release and source package.

osv_package.description: ECOSYSTEM|NAME|VERSION: the OSV ecosystem (Debian:12, Alpine:v3.19, Red Hat, ...), the source package and its version; absent for a non-distro component or one whose release or source the SBOM does not state.

name: security.sbom-component
